descriptionChirho: To shout or cry aloud, typically as an expression of distress, anguish, or urgent appeal to God or others (Qal and Piel stems).
To be called together or summoned as a group, used in the Nifal (passive) stem to indicate people being gathered by proclamation.
To actively summon or convoke people, calling them together for assembly (Hifil causative stem).
